Warhammer Survivors is OUT NOW on Steam, GOG, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 1 and 2, and Android and iOS devices.  

PLAY NOW - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3669620/Warhammer_Survivors/

Thrust into a universe of relentless war, become the embodiment of bullet hell in Warhammer Survivors, a fast-paced roguelite survivors game. Play as champions from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes, collect and upgrade iconic weapons and destroy endless swarms of enemies.

🩻 Find out more: https://www.aurochdigital.com/warhammer-survivors
